*Data as of 30 Sep 2026, 08:57 UTC.*

Fair Isaac is experiencing severe downward pressure, marked by a historic single-day drop and trading near its 52-week low alongside strong year-over-year revenue growth. Recent media coverage is decidedly bearish, driven by major regulatory developments targeting the company's mortgage scoring monopoly.

Is the FICO Score’s Near Monopoly Over?](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=8809562bcbb5af42f283ede3c89961cc770c604521c22e7565fc42e2297a3fbb) - Yahoo, 2026-09-29)
- Plans announced by the administration and the FHFA to dismantle the long-standing mortgage scoring monopoly triggered a historic sell-off, though specific details may affect the ultimate impact ([FICO Stock Plunges 26% in Worst Day Ever as FHFA Dismantles Its 30-Year Mortgage Monopoly — But One Buried Detail May Limit the Damage](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=6fda707e3f47edaa42b2cdebee564a00f1ab0948595595791fe2aeee5741e84c) - Yahoo, 2026-09-29)

## Things to watch
- The tension between strong historical top-line growth and the sudden impairment of its core mortgage monopoly position creates uncertainty around future earnings durability.
- Specific regulatory implementation details regarding the FHFA and administration plans could alter the severity of the disruption to the company's mortgage scoring business model.
